titles.romaji: Yowai Robot to 10 no Story Project
titles.native: 弱いロボットと10のストーリー Project

description:
The project is inspired by "weak robot", it is a project to produce 10 stories to think about the "friendly relations" between the robot and the human. Recruiting from 1 to 10 pieces of comics/short stories with an original robot focus, two of the best works would receive an animated short.

(Source: Official Vimeo channel)

This entry includes:
1) april12：弱いロボットと10のストーリー, released Mar 22, 2016.
2) Minna de Otsukai (みんなでおつかい：弱いロボットと10のストーリー), released Mar 22, 2016.
